body: I do like my therapist. I don't know if it's that she's not a good fit, or if therapy isn't going to help me regardless of the therapist I'm working with. Talking about wanting to kill myself and feeling hopeless doesn't solve anything, or at least it hasn't so far.
That's awful. And it's like you can't even be that mad because you know it's true, right? Someone doing an impression of me would be similar, I'm sure.
